bullets.text: Minister Dr. R. Kumar inspected rain water removal works in Velachery, and the office should track ongoing pumping operations.
Polimer News reported that Velachery is floating in floods with 20 motors deployed, and the office must monitor subsequent actions.
Velachery residents demanded a permanent solution for flooding as emergency pumping cannot substitute for a scientifically-validated mitigation plan.
Heavy overnight rain caused waterlogging in Velachery, T Nagar and other areas, prompting school holidays in four districts including Chennai and Thiruvallur.
Rain caused severe commuting issues on the Tambaram-Velachery Road where an ambulance overturned, and the office should watch road safety.
Heavy rain caused waterlogging on Taramani main road causing traffic jams, and the office should monitor drainage efforts.
GCC Commissioner Sameeran stated that 220 special camps are ready and 1,212 complaints were received regarding Chennai rain impacts.
Greater Chennai Corporation reopened 22 subways and bus routes as waterlogging eased, and the office should oversee full clearance.
Heavy rains flooded residential areas in Ponneri and Minjur, and the office must coordinate relief and water removal.
Gummidipoondi MLA S. Vijayakumar inspected flood relief works and deployed motor pumps to clear stagnant rainwater following news reports.
Collector S. Kavitha released the draft polling station list for the ten assembly constituencies in Thiruvallur district.
Vultr and AMD are deploying AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs in a 20 MW AI supercluster in Chennai, creating India's largest AMD cluster.
Tamil Nadu has begun IT procurement through ELCOT for Phase-III of the paperless e-Courts project to modernise state courts.
MeitY formed a team to investigate an eMudhra security incident involving weak secret keys, and the office should monitor compliance.
Farmers association members held a road blockade in five places across Thiruvallur demanding full cooperative crop loan waiver, leading to 200 arrests.
Red Pix reported allegations regarding bribes taken from foreign companies for data centre approvals, and the office should monitor developments.
Chief Minister Vijay launched a rain-water harvesting awareness campaign highlighting the importance of conserving water, and the office should support local drives.
